what_happened.line: The School Committee accepted proposed extended day rates for PD days and school vacation weeks, set as an hourly rate in place of the regular fee for that day.
The committee approved the personnel report as presented and out-of-state travel for the cross-country team.
The committee approved a small line-item transfer from high school office supplies to art supplies, requested because more students enrolled in art than expected.
The facilities director presented the FY21 to FY30 capital plan, centred on repairs at Turkey Hill, with FY21 requests for asbestos work and air conditioning design.
The committee approved the kindness rocks project; the minutes record the vote but the mover and tally were not audible.

why_it_matters: The extended day rates set what families pay for care on PD days and vacation weeks, so they touch household child-care costs.
The capital plan lists multi-year Turkey Hill repairs, which would be paid through future budgets and so could reach tax bills and later capital votes.
